notes: Card: ' of' x5, ' the' x4, ' among' x3, ' amongst', after 'one' and in 'among the worst'. The - pole has ' peak', ' forefront', ' leader', ' zenith'. Probe: among the worst 0.80, amongst the friendliest 0.77, one of the greatest 0.35; spy among the guests 0.02, One of the dogs 0.03.
